name: Robotgirl Meets Human!
original_name: ロボットガール・ミーツ・ヒューマン！
source:
The day when humans disappeared, a shooting star shone in the sky...

In an empty laboratory, a robot girl, Scarlet, wakes up. She was created with the mission of "make smile as much people as possible", and shortly after her awakening, she decides to embark on a journey to find any human she could.

You will play the role of "Mother", a computer that manages all the robots around the world, and guide her. Don't worry, though! Scarlet is a smart robot, so all you have to do is act according to what she needs.

[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2002410/The_Robot_Girl_Meets_The_Human/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
人类消失的那天，天空中划过一颗流星……

在一个空荡荡的实验室里，一个机器人女孩斯嘉丽醒来了。她的使命是“让尽可能多的人微笑”，在她觉醒后不久，她决定踏上寻找她能找到的人类的旅程。

你将扮演“母亲”的角色，一台管理世界各地所有机器人的电脑，并引导她。不过别担心！Scarlet是一个智能机器人，所以你所要做的就是根据她的需要采取行动。

[编辑自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2002410/The_Robot_Girl_Meets_The_Human/]Steam[/url]]
